title: Roth vs Traditional Calculator
description: Compare after-tax future values of Roth vs traditional contributions with growth and tax assumptions.
howto: Enter the annual contribution, years invested, and expected annual return.
Enter your current tax rate and your expected tax rate in retirement.
Read the after-tax future value of each path.
Compare the difference and the verdict.

faqs.a: Traditional: tax deduction now, tax on withdrawals later. Roth: pay tax now, tax-free withdrawals later. This tool compares the after-tax future value of each.
When your retirement tax rate is higher than today's rate. When it is lower, traditional usually wins. Equal rates make them equivalent.
No. It compares equal gross contributions; real-world limits and eligibility rules are not modeled.
